shortDescription: Krispy Kreme, Inc. (NASDAQ:DNUT) (“Krispy Kreme”, “KKI”, or the “Company”) today announced a franchise development agreement with Original Entrepreneurs LLC (“Original Entrepreneurs”) to open 33 Krispy Kreme shops across the New York metro area over the next five years, expanding the brand's presen…

children: ) (“Krispy Kreme”, “KKI”, or the “Company”) today announced a franchise development agreement with Original Entrepreneurs LLC (“Original Entrepreneurs”) to open 33 Krispy Kreme shops across the New York metro area over the next five years, expanding the brand's presence in one of the country's largest consumer markets.

The shops will be developed in New York City and the surrounding region, including Long Island and New Jersey. The Original Entrepreneurs group, a long-time Krispy Kreme franchisee and experienced quick-service restaurant operator, currently operates 12 Krispy Kreme shops.

“We're pleased to continue growing with Original Entrepreneurs,” said Krispy Kreme CEO Josh Charlesworth. “This development agreement reflects our focus on capital-light franchise growth and enables us to expand with an operator that has deep expertise building and operating Krispy Kreme shops in a competitive market.”
“We're proud of our long-standing relationship with Krispy Kreme and confident in the strength of the brand,” said Karl Halligan, Principal of Original Entrepreneurs.
“We look forward to building on that relationship and continuing to expand Krispy Kreme’s presence across the New York metro area,” said John Mondry, Principal of Original Entrepreneurs.

Headquartered in Charlotte, N.C., Krispy Kreme is one of the most beloved and well-known sweet treat brands in the world. Our iconic Original Glazed® doughnut is universally recognized for its hot-off-the-line, melt-in-your-mouth experience. Krispy Kreme operates in more than 40 countries through its unique network of fresh doughnut shops, partnerships with leading retailers, and a rapidly growing digital business. Our purpose of touching and enhancing lives through the joy that is Krispy Kreme guides how we operate every day and is reflected in the love we have for our people, our communities and the planet. Connect with Krispy Kreme Doughnuts at www.KrispyKreme.com, or on one of its many social media channels, including www.Facebook.com/KrispyKreme and www.X.com/KrispyKreme.

Headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey, Original Entrepreneurs opened its first Krispy Kreme Hot Light Theater shop in 2017 and has since expanded across New Jersey and New York. Following its initial Jersey City opening, the company added locations in Springfield, East Rutherford, Paramus and Lakewood, New Jersey, before entering the New York market. With a focus on strategic expansion, customer service and convenient access to fresh Krispy Kreme doughnuts, Original Entrepreneurs continues to grow its presence across the region.
